mission_phase: Generation 12 - Dress Up Ecommerce Executive Report
focus: Create a Dress Up executive customer-experience opportunity report from public ecommerce evidence, same-query boutique peer references, and appendix-level method evidence.
reason_generation_started: User asked to create a similar report for Dress Up after the High Country report workflow.
reason_generation_ended: The Dress Up report PDF was generated, updated to mention same-query peer analysis in the executive narrative, and updated so Dress Up appears as the current-site baseline beside Red Dress, Pink Lily, and Impressions in the appendix benchmark tables.

validators.tool: pdfinfo / pdftotext / pdftoppm / rendered page spot checks
validators.category: Usability / UI Standards / Content Integrity Validation

evidence_quality_notes: Dress Up was evaluated with 70 protected shopper-language examples across seven discovery concepts.
The report uses Red Dress, Pink Lily, and Impressions as comparable boutique reference implementations, not as competitor-superiority claims.
Dress Up now appears first in the appendix benchmark tables as the current-site baseline: 69 usable search rows averaging 93%, 70 autocomplete rows averaging 52%, and 70 total examples.
Executive pages mention same-query peer analysis while keeping Dress Up's customer experience as the headline.
No internal analytics, revenue, search logs, conversion data, paid-media data, or customer records were available.
